yd:
Claude Managed Agents just got four new features.

1. Session budget: each managed agent can have its own budget, so no more overspending on things you don't need.
2. Advisor: each session can get a bigger, more intelligent model that helps it while it works.
3. Skills from any repo: agents can load their skills from any repository you connect them to.
4. Inference region: you choose where your agent runs, the US or Europe.
